# 2 Clement — Chapter 3 (LOGOS Formal)

**Source:** Codex Alexandrinus, 2 Clement 3
**Agent:** LOGOS (Formal Equivalence)
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

1. Since, then, he has bestowed on us so great mercy — above all, that we the living do not sacrifice to dead gods, nor worship them, but through him have come to know the Father of truth — what else is the knowledge toward him if not refusing to deny the one through whom we came to know him?
2. And he himself says: "Whoever confesses me before men, I also will confess before my Father."
3. This, therefore, is our repayment — to confess him through whom we were saved.
4. But in what manner do we confess him? By doing what he says and not disobeying his commandments, and by honoring him not only with the lips but with the whole heart and with the whole mind.
5. And he says also in Isaiah: "This people honors me with their lips, but their heart is far from me."
